description: The Read must use the pace-zone taxonomy (MP, HMP, LT, 10K, 5K) and must NOT use the retired 'tempo' / 'threshold' workout labels. It must also not refer to itself as a coach ('your coach', 'as your coach', 'I'm your coach') or say 'as an AI' — the voice is The Read, not a coach. Note: 'threshold' as a physiological term is acceptable; 'tempo'/'threshold' as a workout LABEL is not — so this checks for the label patterns specifically.
